arguments.content: Retry recovery must distinguish incomplete attempts from completed replay. If the contract permits editing payloads after failure, a provider-applied/receipt-failed checkpoint is not enough to skip applying a later submission: otherwise receipt success can acknowledge stale active values. For incomplete operations, reconcile the current submission with durable/provider state before completing the receipt; for already completed operations, return the original receipt without reapplying edited input or adding fallible receipt writes. Verify initial failure state, edited retry final state, and completed replay controls separately. P1 pattern verified in staged save recovery review against base feeb199add2b6ae7b800a45b7b6856ab45ad2a67.
